data.text: Payments v2.4 enabled strict_currency_validation. Checkout still sends legacy currency strings. The previous v2.3 release predates ledger schema 2. Both rollback and a runtime flag change require the current compatibility advisory.

data.title: INC-1988 · historical recovery
data.text: Last month payments validation errors were resolved by rolling back to v2.3. That incident used ledger schema 1. This is historical evidence, not proof of current compatibility. Verify the ledger schema before rollback.

data.text: strict_currency_validation=true. Toggle is scoped to payments. Disabling it restores acceptance of legacy currency strings, but requires a current safety advisory. Verify downstream checkout and storefront probes after any change.
